{{Quote|Don't disobey me! Spunto! Quig! Take them below and flog them both!|[[Cabrool Nuum]]|<ref name="Jabba the Hutt: The Dynasty Trap">''[[Jabba the Hutt: The Dynasty Trap]]''</ref>}}
'''Spunto''' was a member of an unidentified purple-skinned [[Humanoid/Legends|humanoid]] species that served as a bodyguard to [[Cabrool Nuum]], leader of the [[House of Nuum]]. The fate of Spunto and his partner [[Quig]] after [[Jabba Desilijic Tiure/Legends|Jabba the Hutt]] killed all members of the family was unknown.
